subject: Scheduling: Redwood demo for Finova — timezone options and DST note

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@finova.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:22:00-05:00
Subject: Intro + Redwood demo — timezone availability

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the intro (Vanessa, great to meet you). We at Finova are evaluating inference platforms for customer-facing workflows and would love a 30–45 minute walkthrough focused on latency, deployment options, and cost controls.

We have a few stakeholders who need to attend: myself (East Coast US), Samir (also East Coast), and one of our London-based engineers may drop in. To make scheduling easier, here are windows that work for us (all ET):
- Tue Nov 24: 08:30–10:30 ET
- Wed Nov 25: 08:00–09:30 ET

We realize DST flips can make conversions messy — our UK engineer mentioned the EU end-of-DST was earlier this month, so wanted to call that out. If you can propose a 30–45 min slot inside one of those windows and confirm what time that will be for your EU team (CET/BST/etc.), that would be great.

Looking forward — we can do an invite once we confirm.

Best,
Alex Morgan
Product lead, Finova
--

We can do a 30–45 minute session during the Tue Nov 24 window. Suggested slot: Tue Nov 24, 08:30–09:15 ET — that is Tue Nov 24, 14:30–15:15 CET for our EU team (CET is UTC+1 now that DST has ended). I double-checked local offsets so everyone’s on the same page.

Rishi and Marissa, are you both available to join that slot? Rishi, can you lead the technical demo and cover deployment/latency bits? Marissa, can you cover pricing/rollout options and share the deck?

I’ll tentatively hold the slot and send an invite once we confirm.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
